messages.subject: gl.filter.sexlinked() finds no sex-linked markers
parts:
Hi, 
I attended the recent workshop and wish to filter sex-linked loci from my dataset first, as recommended by Diana. However, the gl.filter.sexlinked() function doesn't seem to identify any sex-linked markers. This happened for both my data and platypus.gl test data. Any help would be greatly appreciated.  TIA 


> res <- gl.filter.sexlinked(platypus.gl, filter = "drop")

messages.author: af7bdc81cec01a55
messages.subject: Re: gl.filter.sexlinked() finds no sex-linked markers
parts:
Hi there,

The new version of funciton gl.filter.sexlinked is in the package "dartR.sexlinked". You have to install first that package. However, the latest working version is not on CRAN but on github dev branch. I recommend following these steps:

# Install dartRverse package
install.packages("dartRverse")

# Load dartRverse package
library(dartRverse)

# Use a function in dartRverse package to install dartR.sexlinked package
dartRverse::dartRverse_install(package = "dartR.sexlinked", rep = "github", branch = "dev")

# Load dartR.sexlinked package
library(dartR.sexlinked)

And that's it! You can test the function on one of the example datasets included in dartR.sexlinked. For example:

# Load example dataset EYR
load('./data/EYR.rda')

# Inspect EYR dataset
EYR

# Use gl.filter.sexlinked function
res <- dartR.sexlinked::gl.filter.sexlinked(gl = EYR, system = "zw")

Let me know if have more questions!
Diana
